items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: I had a trio at the Village Vanguard with Jimmy Dutts(?) and a boy named Jackson on the guitar.

ctx.x: I think we got a little bit sidetracked here. Anyway, basically you're now into the Fifties, practically, and you're working with all kinds of trios and so forth. So I haven't much guidance here I can give you. For instance, how long...? Here they say with your own trio, long residences at Wells, Village Vanguard, Basin Street East, the Shalimar, Frank's Steak House...
I had a trio at the Village Vanguard with Jimmy Dutts(?) and a boy named Jackson on the guitar.
Jimmy Dutts(?) is a bass player.
